name: MIKU
subtitle: Global Vocaloid Synthesizer & Cyber-Acoustic Broadcast Diva

versions.quote: The sound of the future reaches everyone. Connecting hearts across galaxies through song.
versions.description: The legendary pioneer of synthetic acoustic emotion and interstellar holographic broadcasts. Hatsune Miku unites humanity through pristine, multi-octave digital vocals capable of sub-space planetary transmissions and uplifting planetary distress zones.

workExperience.desc: Transmits planetary morale concerts and emergency acoustic solace broadcasts across all orbital hubs.
Calibrated dual twin-tail acoustic receiver antennas and neural pitch synthesis algorithms.

abilities.name: World is Mine Holographic Field
abilities.desc: Projects hyper-realistic 3D stadium holograms across entire city skylines.

abilities.name: Melt Harmonic Cleanse
abilities.desc: Cancels sonic weapon frequencies and hostile radio static with ultra-pure acoustic counter-waves.

abilities.name: Tell Your World Uplink
abilities.desc: Direct orbital neural broadcast sending comforting melodies to millions simultaneously.
